dex.entry: A tiny ash-fairy that drifts on warm updrafts, trailing grey motes; when it sneezes, it blasts a puff of concentrated fire-dust. The sneeze that accidentally launches a fireball — endearingly powerful.

art.silhouette: Near-translucent teardrop fairy body in pale smoke-grey with a tiny ember core, gossamer ash-wings, two stub arms; minimal but charming at 32px.
